# presign-guard

> Pre-sign safety checks for AI agents and wallets: before an agent signs a transaction, a token approval, a Permit/Permit2/EIP-3009 signature or a message, presign-guard answers green, orange or red with reason codes (known drainers, sanctioned addresses, unlimited approvals, look-alike tokens, simulated balance changes). Also token safety verdicts (honeypot, rug pull, mint or freeze authority, unlocked liquidity), wallet approval audits, OFAC SDN sanctions screening of any address, and prompt-injection checks for text an agent receives. EVM chains, Solana, the XRP Ledger and Algorand. Free quick checks; paid verdicts from $0.01 per call over x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, USD₮0 on X Layer) or MPP; errors are never charged. MCP server at https://presign-guard.fizzl.eu/mcp.

On red: don't sign. On orange: tell the owner why before going on. No account or API key needed; every paid answer carries a signed receipt.

## For agents
- [Agent instructions (skill.md)](https://presign-guard.fizzl.eu/skill.md): every check, its input, and how to pay
- Agent skill: `npx skills add Fizzl13/presign-guard`, or in Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add Fizzl13/x402-doctor` then `/plugin install presign-guard@fizzl`. Every Fizzl skill: https://github.com/Fizzl13/fizzl-skills
- [OpenAPI](https://presign-guard.fizzl.eu/openapi.json): every paid route with its price, input and output schema
- [x402 discovery document](https://presign-guard.fizzl.eu/.well-known/x402)
- MCP server (streamable HTTP): https://presign-guard.fizzl.eu/mcp, with the free tools `presign_quick_check`, `token_quick_verdict` and `injection_quick_check`

## Paid API
- `POST /v1/check` ($0.01): verdict and reason codes for a transaction, approval, signature or message about to be signed (EVM, `type: "solana"`, `"xrpl"` or `"algorand"`)
- `POST /v1/check/explain` ($0.03): the same plus a plain-language explanation for the owner (English or Dutch)
- `GET /v1/token?chain=<chain>&address=<token>` ($0.01): is this token safe to buy, or a honeypot or rug pull? Grade, reasons and market data
- `GET /v1/approvals?chain=<chain>&address=<wallet>` ($0.02): every open approval of a wallet and which to revoke
- `GET /v1/screen?address=<address>` ($0.01): is this wallet sanctioned? Any chain's address against the OFAC SDN list
- `POST /v1/injection` ($0.01): is this text a prompt-injection trap for your agent? A web page, email, tool result, API answer or another agent's message that tries to make it pay, leak keys or ignore its instructions
- `GET /v1/credits`: prepaid credit packs (100 checks for $0.80, 1,000 for $7.00)

## Free
- `GET /v1/sanctions`: the OFAC SDN digital-currency addresses as open data, synced from the US Treasury
- `POST /v1/injection/quick`: the prompt-injection verdict only (green/orange/red), for texts up to 8,000 characters, 10 free calls an hour
- `POST /v1/check/quick`: the pre-sign verdict only (green/orange/red), same body as `POST /v1/check`, within the same 10 free calls an hour
- [Website](https://presign-guard.fizzl.eu/): what each check catches, with examples

## Optional
- [Fizzl](https://fizzl.eu/llms.txt): the other Fizzl services (x402 Doctor, agent wallet, trading signals)
- [Agent wallet with these checks built in](https://wallet.fizzl.eu/skill.md)
- [Source code](https://github.com/Fizzl13/presign-guard)

## Fizzl Pass
A Fizzl Pass holder (Bronze comes with Agent Wallet Pro) sends its signed proof in the `X-Fizzl-Pass` header and gets 5 times the free limits, counted per pass instead of per IP. The proof comes from the Agent Wallet dashboard; anyone can check a wallet's pass at https://wallet.fizzl.eu/v1/pass/status?wallet=<address>.

Credit back: after a paid check from a wallet a pass covers, 10% of the price (Silver 20%, Gold 30%) goes into the pass's vault, spendable at presign-guard, x402 Doctor, Ichimoku Signal and Fizzl Buy. A paid call with the `X-Fizzl-Pass` header and no payment is paid from the vault when it holds enough (response header `x-fizzl-vault: paid`); a failed call gives it back. Balance: GET https://presign-guard.fizzl.eu/v1/vault with the same header. Credit can only be spent at Fizzl and can't be paid out; Bronze and Silver credit ends 12 months after the last credit.
